prompt:
SCENE: A tatami room, 16:9. Locked three-quarter on a six-fold gold-leaf byobu standing in a zigzag. The gold is plain — no painted scene, no famous composition. An adult is not in frame. No readable writing.

ACTION: The gold starts dim. A cooler band of window daylight slides across the folds as if a shutter opened, then holds. Light faces and shadow faces of the folds stay in place. The screen does not walk. This is not a wipe.

FOCUS: Tack-sharp on the gold leaf grain and one fold edge at center. Far tatami is one stop soft.

PHYSICS: Gold reflects. It does not sparkle like glitter. The screen has weight and stays planted. No CGI shimmer loop.

LIGHT: One window from the left. Specular runs along the gold, then settles. No museum even-fill. No electric color.

STYLE: Photoreal cinematic, period Japan, gold leaf and lacquered frame, soft grain. No anime. No text. No watermark. No logos.

post.originalText:
I almost put a painting on this screen. The gold looked borrowed.
最初は屏風に絵を入れかけた。金だけだと物足りないと思った。

I took the painting out. Then the window light finally had somewhere to go.
でも絵を外したら、光が走る場所ができた。残したのはそのテイクです。

translations.zh:
场景：榻榻米房间，16:9。固定四分之三机位拍摄呈折线展开的六曲纯金箔屏风。画面无人物、无文字。

动作：金箔起初昏暗，随后一道清冷的窗外天光掠过折面后停驻，明暗面保持静止。

对焦与物理：中心折边及金箔纹理清晰。金箔真实反光而非亮片闪烁，屏风稳固无位移。

光影与风格：单侧窗光，真实反光蔓延后稳定。日本传统时期写实电影质感，带微弱颗粒。
